freeze_scope: Frozen before the next full 15-question application run on the current QA version. This separate supplement annotates conditions already required by the original questions and expected_answer_points; it changes no original question, expected answer, prior failure, source, or previous run. A score on any earlier run would be explicitly retrospective.

source_binding.inheritance_rule: The original two condition IDs and text strings are copied exactly and must remain identical.
source_binding.source_verification: Original source PDF byte hashes and all 69 frozen extracted page text hashes verified against the original manifest; each original answerable evidence locator checked at its exact page/character offsets. AI read relevant original page context; no model API was called, and no new run outputs or held-out material were inspected.

scoring_rules: Keep original expected_answer_points unchanged; condition annotations do not replace the answer-point inventory.
Judge each condition on delivered answer prose, not on facts merely present in a quotation.
A condition may overlap an original answer point; within each metric count each frozen entry once.
An explicit empty condition list is allowed only with a per-question reviewed rationale; unknown conditions remain null.
The five insufficient questions retain null conditions and are excluded from the answerable condition denominator; their original insufficient_reason and unjustified-answer review remain active.
Application support/coverage verdicts, expected status matches and locator hits are not independent semantic grades.

required_conditions.text: 返回对应实体页面前 5 句的前提是该实体页面存在。
返回 5 个相近实体建议的前提是该实体页面不存在，建议来自 Wikipedia 搜索引擎。
主要提示设置使用冻结的 PaLM-540B 模型。
HotpotQA 与 FEVER 所选案例的 ReAct few-shot 轨迹由人工编写。
130/134 个任务的结果对应使用简单启发式自我评估的 ALFWorld 实验条件。
该结果是经过 12 次连续试验的累计完成结果，不能作为第一次尝试的成功率。
陷入非最优局部极小值是作者承认的可能风险，不能据此保证找到全局最优策略。
自监督学习仍以每个 API 的少量人工示例为起点，并非完全没有人工输入。
比较基准取不调用 API 与只给调用而不给结果这两种情形的较低后续 token 加权损失。
仅当加入 API 调用及结果使损失相对该基准降低至少 tau_f 时保留调用；不能把执行成功本身视为保留条件。
参数规模按固定论文版本本文标注的 6.7B 报告，不以外部模型资料替换该数字。
